data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Ketzia means 'crown of strength' or 'girded with a crown'. It is derived from the Hebrew word 'katz', meaning 'crown' or 'strength'. In the Bible, Ketzia is mentioned as one of the virgins who anointed Jesus with costly perfume. The name Ketzia carries the meaning “Crown of strength” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Ketzia usually hope their child will grow to embody crown of strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Κητσία
